limitations: Linux desktop responsive widths; no mobile OS, popout, or screen-reader run.
Default light/dark themes plus a custom accent override; no third-party theme matrix.
Partial fixture intentionally intercepts getFileCache for one synthetic note; other fixtures use real native caches.
Capture/derivation/layout/render measurements are a single host observation; render covers synchronous DOM construction, not paint/frame-rate.
Topology IO counters cover the explicit load window; fixture edits and language-setting writes happen outside it.
Host Obsidian updater is separate from topology; topology has no network/provider dependencies.
screenshotCapture: A separate 24-case repeat of islands/large refreshed crops; identical production assets.
